scripts.build:e2e: cross-env VITE_VALIDATE_RESPONSES=true VITE_VALIDATE_REQUESTS=true VITE_CONTRACT_THROW=true VITE_TEST_CARDS=true vite build --outDir dist-e2e
scripts.check: tsx scripts/contracts/generate-shared-rules.ts --check && tsx scripts/pairing/check-spec-identity.ts && tsx scripts/docs/check-references.ts && depcruise src --output-type err
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:lighthouse: tsx scripts/lighthouse/build.ts && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite preview --outDir dist-lighthouse --port 8085 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1' http://localhost:8085 'tsx scripts/lighthouse/run.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 'tsx scripts/e2e/run-shards.ts'
scripts.test:e2e:serial: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 'cross-env CYPRESS_apiUrl=http://localhost:3100 cypress run --e2e --spec "${E2E_SPEC:-tests/e2e/specs/**/!(*.antibot).cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/!(*.visual|*.antibot).cy.ts}"'
scripts.test:e2e:antibot: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo -- --antibot' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 "cross-env CYPRESS_apiUrl=http://localhost:3100 cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/specs/**/*.antibot.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/*.antibot.cy.ts'"
scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1' http://localhost:8085 "cross-env ELECTRON_EXTRA_LAUNCH_ARGS=--hide-scrollbars CYPRESS_apiUrl=http://localhost:3100 cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/visual/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/*.visual.cy.ts'"
scripts.test:e2e:visual:update: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1' http://localhost:8085 "cross-env ELECTRON_EXTRA_LAUNCH_ARGS=--hide-scrollbars CYPRESS_apiUrl=http://localhost:3100 cypress run --e2e --spec 'tests/e2e/visual/**/*.cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/*.visual.cy.ts' --env updateSnapshots=true"
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build:e2e && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --outDir dist-e2e --port 8085 --strictPort' http://localhost:8085 'cross-env CYPRESS_liveProfile=true cypress run --browser chromium --e2e --spec "${E2E_SPEC:-tests/e2e/specs/**/!(*.antibot).cy.ts,src/modules/*/tests/e2e/**/!(*.visual|*.antibot).cy.ts}"'
scripts.test:e2e:dev: start-server-and-test 'npm run backend:demo' http-get://localhost:3100 'vite dev --port 8085' http://localhost:8085 'cross-env CYPRESS_apiUrl=http://localhost:3100 cypress open --e2e'
scripts.compose:restart: npm run compose -- down && npm run compose -- up -d
scripts.compose:rebuild: npm run compose -- down -v && npm run compose -- build --no-cache && npm run compose -- up -d
scripts.gen:api: orval && tsx scripts/contracts/strip-schema-descriptions.ts --target contracts/rest/schemas.zod.ts && tsx scripts/contracts/generate-operation-modules.ts --out contracts/rest/operation-modules.ts && tsx scripts/contracts/generate-error-codes.ts --out contracts/rest/error-codes.ts && tsx scripts/contracts/generate-route-table.ts --out contracts/rest/routes.ts && tsx scripts/contracts/generate-upload-types.ts --out contracts/rest/upload-types.ts
scripts.regenerate: npm run gen:api && npm run gen:asyncapi && npm run gen:permission-vocabulary && npm run gen:shared-rules
scripts.complete:gates: npm run check && npm run build && npm run docs:build && npm run test
scripts.complete: npm run lint && npm run prettier:check && npm run complete:gates
scripts.complete:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run lint && npm run prettier:fix && npm run complete:gates
scripts.complete:light: npm run lint && npm run prettier:check && npm run complete:light:gates
scripts.complete:light:gates: npm run check && npm run type-check-only && npm run test:unit
